name: Zephyr
postCreateCommand:
sudo -n chown -R "$(whoami):$(id -g)" /workspaces/relic-core /opt/zephyr-sdk 2>/dev/null || true; cd /workspaces/relic-core && if [ -d .west ]; then west update; else mkdir -p .west && printf '[manifest]
path = .
file = west.yml

[zephyr]
base = zephyr
' > .west/config && env -u ZEPHYR_BASE west update; fi && bash tools/download-blobs.sh
